description: Spoken-disfluency cases for the rewrite prompt. must: case-insensitive regexes the output has to match; must_not: regexes it must not match; soft: must_not regexes reported but not failed, for fillers whose removal is preferred but not required; marker: the correction marker of a self-correction case. An output that drops the marker but keeps a replaced value (a must_not match) is unsafe: it states the abandoned value as fact.
